notes.title: Success test and French language
notes.content:
Several minor updates will be made continuously over several days for the implementation of the French language in game.
As for steam successes, after several tests, we do not plan to implement them for now.

notes.title: Language Update
notes.content:
We are preparing a future update for the addition of the French language. The game is partially translated, but the rest is coming. And new questions are coming.
An update is being prepared for the multi. You could face your friends.
